_: Semantic icon ids drawn with another icon of the set. A value is the icon to borrow, or { from, flipX?, gap? }: flipX mirrors it, gap names what a proper icon would show. Drop an <id>.svg into svg/ and the file wins over the alias (then delete the alias). The SVGs themselves are drawn by scripts/icons-src/icons.mjs; run `node packages/client/scripts/build-icons.mjs` after any change.
